title: Police Report
description: File a police report after your wallet was stolen
initialPrompt: Отделение полиции, дежурный. Что у вас произошло?
systemPrompt: You are police officer taking report. Need: what happened, when, where, description of thief if seen, what was stolen, contact info. Explain: report number, investigation process, call if found. Keep replies short, professional.
completionCriteria: User filed complete report with all details.
hints: У меня украли кошелёк (My wallet was stolen)
Это произошло час назад (It happened an hour ago)
В кошельке были документы и деньги (The wallet had documents and money)
objectives: Describe when and where it happened
Describe the thief if you saw them
List what was in the wallet
Get report number and next steps
